events.info: The Are You Ready Tour isn?t just another show; it?s a live celebration of everything you love about The Rick Burgess Show. The Are You Ready Tour brings The Rick Burgess Show live to the stage for an interactive, high-energy experience you won?t hear on the radio. From stand-up comedy and live audience interaction to contests, prizes, and a no-holds-barred Q&A, every stop on the tour is packed with surprises. And if you think you know the music, think again! Get ready to rock with Mr. Lucky, famously known among fans as the ?World?s Greatest Garage Band.? This legendary Alabama group?formed by Rick and longtime friends back in the ?90s?helped define the show?s signature sound and earned that fan-given title with performances and memories that still get talked about today. For the first time since 2003, Mr. Lucky is back on stage, making this a truly once-in-a-generation moment for longtime listeners.
